pictures.name: ZSO1-Dark-Forest
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. A deep, tangled jungle path at dusk, giant trees and hanging vines, a little gold light breaking through: Mardana, a Muslim musician with a greying beard and a simple cap, a wooden rabab on his back, walks alone, peering warily into the shadows, looking for fruit. Deep blue shadows, suspense, no danger shown.

pictures.name: ZSO3-The-Song
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. The same clearing: Guru Nanak in a long saffron-brown robe and simple turban, seen only from behind, steps into the firelight with one hand raised, singing. The fire beneath the iron pot burns low and the pot is still, with no steam. Kauda freezes, astonished. Mardana, a Muslim musician with a greying beard and a simple cap looks up with hope. A soft golden glow fills the clearing. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.
